title: Semantically Labelled Automata for Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning with LTL Instructions
abstract: arXiv:2602.06746v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study multi-task reinforcement learning (RL), a setting in which an agent learns a single, universal policy capable of generalising to arbitrary, possibly unseen tasks. We consider tasks specified as linear temporal logic (LTL) formulae, which are commonly used in formal methods to specify properties of systems, and have recently been successfully adopted in RL. In this setting, we present a novel task embedding technique leveraging a new generation of semantic LTL-to-automata translations, originally developed for temporal synthesis. The resulting semantically labelled automata contain rich, structured information in each state that allow us to (i) compute the automaton efficiently on-the-fly, (ii) extract expressive task embeddings used to condition the policy, and (iii) naturally support full LTL. translated_title: 基于语义标注自动机的多任务强化学习与LTL指令
translated_abstract: 我们研究了多任务强化学习（RL），这是一种智能体学习一个通用策略，能够泛化到任意、可能未见过的任务的设置。我们考虑任务被指定为线性时序逻辑（LTL）公式，这在形式方法中常用于指定系统属性，并最近在RL中得到了成功应用。在此设置下，我们提出了一种新颖的任务嵌入技术，利用新一代语义LTL到自动机翻译，该翻译最初是为时序综合开发的。生成的语义标注自动机在每个状态中包含丰富、结构化的信息，这使我们能够（i）在线高效计算自动机，（ii）提取用于条件化策略的表达性任务嵌入，以及（iii）自然支持完整的LTL。在多种领域的实验结果表明，我们的方法达到了最先进的性能，并且能够扩展。
tldr: 本文提出了一种利用语义标注自动机的新任务嵌入方法，用于多任务强化学习，能够高效处理完整的LTL指令，并实现最先进的性能和可扩展性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a novel task embedding method using semantically labelled automata for multi-task RL, enabling efficient handling of full LTL instructions with state-of-the-art performance and scalability.
